limitations: Projection grants legal item ownership as a declared fixture and phases of finite income; it does not simulate finding/earning every item.
Future phase caps are temporary in-memory CLI planning flags; released maps and browser state do not change.
Income is credited once per projected phase before spending; wallet cap loss is recorded. Real source payments are distributed across actions, so actual cash timing differs.
Normal ordinary loot and optional repeat allowances are excluded from projection income. The real first-chapter route shows those extras can greatly exceed the floor.
Crafting purchases, gems, drills and crystal economy are excluded from this forging-target projection; no full acquisition/gem affordability claim is made.
